test_title: PYST 18: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: JOSV is related to LQUX in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way. EJNQ is related to GLPS. Which of the following is DIMP related to, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- (2) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• 'JOSV’ is written as 'LQUX'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6cd74ca807eeb4e6cd251e266838d1a246891e8fb01f5874fc92eb90875fb03c.png] 

And,

 
• 'EJNQ' is written as 'GLPS'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd36c430e3ae83d779b3dcc4e67c59a0f31d18f361c0f3a5a866c2fb1509dfa7.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'DIMP' is written as 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ae67dd8c8b446b341430ca4441e1f0c70e78203bae9e30c88f521961728022b.png] 

Hence, "**FKOR**" is the correct answer.
